current_activity: LVIII Panzer Corps takes over responsibility at Mortain from the XLVII Panzer Corps
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 25 p. 502: on 12 August the XLVII Panzer Corps headquarters turned over its responsibility at Mortain to the LVIII Panzer Corps and went to Argentan; p. 482: the LVIII Corps, with the 10th SS Panzer Division, had been inserted at Barenton to relieve the weak 275th Division and protect the 2d SS Panzer Division flank. Location: Mortain sector, named as the responsibility passed to the corps. Location approximate: the corps command post is not named; the point is Mortain, precision 10 km.
